Definition: from G4314 and G5087; to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat:--add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more.
BiblicalUsage: Prostithemi means to add, to place beside, to give more, to increase. At Pentecost, about three thousand souls were added unto the church; the apostles said to the Lord, Increase our faith; and Paul says the law was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God is the adder: He added souls to the church, He alone can add faith, and even the law was added by Him for a season.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
